```{julia}
#| echo: false
#| output: false
using Earth2Studio
```

```{julia}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
py_names = filter(names(Earth2Studio; all=true)) do n
    isdefined(Earth2Studio, n) && getfield(Earth2Studio, n) isa Earth2Studio.Py
end
meta = Base.Docs.meta(Earth2Studio)

function julia_docstring(mod::Module, name::Symbol)
    b = Base.Docs.Binding(mod, name)
    haskey(meta, b) || return ""
    docs = meta[b].docs
    isempty(docs) && return ""
    return join(first(values(docs)).text, "")
end

println("## Python module references\n")
println("Nothing is exported. Access each reference as `Earth2Studio.<name>`.\n")
for name in py_names
    doc = julia_docstring(Earth2Studio, name)
    println("""
    ::: {.card .mb-3}
    ::: {.card-header .api-item-header}
    #### `Earth2Studio.$name` {#$(lowercase(string(name)))}
    :::
    ::: {.card-body}
    $doc
    :::
    :::
    """)
end
```
